description: The empty selector on a set whose every entry is skipped at import fails with NoMatchingKey; decided by ADR 0054 §3 (ADR 0041 §2): the unknown kty and the RSA key with a modulus under 2048 bits are both skipped (RFC 7517 §5, SHOULD ignore), so the imported set is empty and zero members match (§4); outcome hand-derived from the ADR 0054 text (conformance/tools/jwk-oracle/specs/select.json), never computed by polyjose
